title: Fair Infinitesimal Jackknife: Mitigating the Influence of Biased Training Data Points Without Refitting
benchmark_measurement: Bias against Muslims in toxicity classification.
findings: The proposed method, Fair-IJ, effectively mitigated group disparities for the 'Muslim' sensitive attribute in toxicity classification tasks on the CivilComments dataset. When applied to BERT and T5 models, Fair-IJ consistently achieved lower disparity scores (ΔΕΟ and ADP) and a better task performance/fairness trade-off compared to baseline models and other fairness methods like Gap Regularization.
references: Naman Agarwal, Brian Bullins, and Elad Hazan. Second-order stochastic optimization for machine learning in linear time. Journal of Machine Learning Research, 18(1):4148–4187, 2017.
